title: Ex-Students in Their Later Years — Ex-Students and an Ex-Teacher
text:

notes: Page contains two sections of photographs. Top section: three portrait photos of ex-students in their later years. Bottom section: four photos captioned 'Ex-Students and an Ex-Teacher.' Some captions are partially obscured or difficult to read at small size; 'Jan. P. Cooper' may be uncertain. 'Robert Roberts' appears as a former name for Judge O. C. Mulkey.
